targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  address as "Address", 
  to_char(to_timestamp(started_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Started At",
  to_char(to_timestamp(valid_until), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Valid Until",
  tx_hash as "TX Hash"
FROM payment_events
ORDER BY "valid_until" DESC
;
